name: Sorted into nine bands, not scored on a line
useWhen: Fifteen to twenty-five candidates where the scoring is a judgement and the bands are what gets argued about.

focal.note: The cell is the unit of meaning, not the item. Everything inside one is a peer.

replacesNote: Pairs with comp-priority-scatter: that one when the spread is real, this one when the bands are what people discuss.

deviations.source: twenty items listed in navy boxes on the left half
deviations.why: Every item in it also appears in the grid with the same label — a legend for names the grid already spells out. Dropping it gives the grid the full canvas, which is what makes nine cells legible.
